title: SpaceX Crew Dragon, Falcon 9 Goes Vertical
description: SpaceX’s Crew Dragon spacecraft and Falcon 9 rocket raised into a vertical position at Launch Complex 39A at NASA’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida, after rolling out from the horizontal integration facility. The spacecraft is designed to ultimately fly astronauts to the International Space Station as part of NASA’s Commercial Crew Program.
